title: framework-support
description: Which compute platforms one framework officially supports, as its own documentation (or the platform maker's) states. A GPU's support is derived from its compute_platform; a platform the record does not list is unknown, not unsupported.

framework.description: the framework record (frameworks content repo) this support statement is about; absent when the Atlas has no such record

checked.description: the day every platform source was last read

supported.description: false only when the source says the platform is not supported

source.description: the page that states it; also listed in sources

min_compute_capability.description: cuda only: the lowest compute capability the source names; a GPU without a compute_capability stays unknown

gpus.description: when the source lists products: only these GPUs; other GPUs of the platform stay unknown

note.description: a qualification the source states (operating system, preview, plugin)
